name: hive-site
//: hivefleet.dev - the public site for Hive, the open-source tool: what it is, how to install it, and the repository's documentation. Next.js App Router + Tailwind v4, exported statically to out/ (the same toolchain as web/hub). Vercel builds and serves it (.github/workflows/deploy-site.yml); nothing here is embedded in the hive binary.

No server, nothing to log in to, no secrets: every page is plain HTML written at build time. The docs pages are the repository's docs/**/*.md (../../docs), rendered by src/lib/markdown.ts and ordered by src/lib/docs.ts; a new file there gets a page without a change here.
prebuild: scripts/prebuild.mjs copies ../../scripts/install.sh to public/install.sh (git-ignored), which the site serves at /install.sh; without the file it says so and the build goes on.

check: `npm run check` = typecheck (next typegen, then tsc --noEmit, so a removed route never fails on stale .next/types) + lint (eslint) + build + test (node --test) + check:out (scripts/check-out.mjs: every internal link and #anchor of the export resolves, every page has its title, description, canonical address and JSON-LD, the sitemap lists exactly what was exported).

dependencies: the Markdown packages (unified, remark-*, rehype-*) run at build time only; none of them reaches the browser. The lockfile holds versions published before 2026-11-17 (the three-day release-age rule): add or update with `npm install --before=<date three days back>`.

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run test && npm run check:out
